# Preliminary Results: significance and confidence (generated by analysis/02_significance.py)

## Data caveat: what these results mean

All results are **demonstrated reliability from the qualification test data in our parameter table**
(test temperature, hours, sample size, failures). The calculation is verified (it reproduces the course
chi-square formula and TI's published FITs), but a part's result only reflects the test data we
transcribed. For four parts the manufacturer's published FIT rests on other or more data than our table:

- **Renesas RH850:** only one 231-device HTOL test is in the table. Renesas's verified published FIT
  (0.0011) rests on much more data, so the RH850 is very likely **more reliable than our result shows**
  (our 60% FIT at 55 C is 15.5).
- **ADI LTC6811-1, ADuM141E, ADuM4135:** our table gives them **lower** FITs (0.32-0.45 at 55 C, 60%)
  than ADI publishes (11-34; LTC6811-1 verified, ADuM4135 not found in ADI's report, ADuM141E not
  checked), so their results **may be optimistic**.

So the supplier comparisons in the MCU, BMS AFE, digital isolator and gate driver slots, and the "least
reliable" combination built from these parts, compare the evidence in our table, not settled true
reliability. No supplier difference is statistically significant (Preliminary Results, 9b).

Condition: 55 C, mission 2,920 h, target R >= 0.999; tests at alpha = 0.05; seed 5300 (20 seeds for Monte Carlo error).

## Part 1: is the simulator trustworthy?
- 1a Simulator vs course chi-square formula (95% max FIT, 10 parts, Ea 0.7): largest difference 0.65%; all |z| < 1.5 (within Monte Carlo error).
- 1b Simulator vs published TI FIT (6 families): mean ratio 0.912 (95% CI 0.695-1.196); one-sample t-test on log10 ratio t = -0.88, p = 0.42: not significantly different from the published values.
- 1c Coverage (log-uniform truth): central 95% interval < 0.1: 36.8% (31.4%-42.4%, p = 5e-171); 0.1-1: 94.0% (90.2%-96.6%, p = 0.46); 1-10: 96.2% (92.6%-98.3%, p = 0.53); > 10: 95.3% (91.7%-97.6%, p = 1); all: 77.0% (74.3%-79.6%, p = 2.4e-84)
  upper 97.5% bound overall 99.8% (95% CI 99.3%-100.0%; test of coverage below 97.5%: p = 1)
- 1c Coverage (uniform truth): central 95% interval < 0.1: 88.9% (51.8%-99.7%, p = 0.37); 0.1-1: 97.8% (92.4%-99.7%, p = 0.33); 1-10: 96.1% (93.3%-98.0%, p = 0.51); > 10: 94.6% (92.5%-96.3%, p = 0.64); all: 95.3% (93.8%-96.5%, p = 0.72)
  upper 97.5% bound overall 98.7% (95% CI 97.8%-99.3%; test of coverage below 97.5%: p = 1)
- 1d Brier score of P(B outlasts A), log-uniform truth: 0.186 (95% bootstrap CI 0.168-0.204); coin flip 0.25
- 1d Brier score of P(B outlasts A), uniform truth: 0.119 (95% bootstrap CI 0.105-0.133); coin flip 0.25
- 1e Monte Carlo error, system FIT (median), most reliable system: mean 7.164, SE per run 0.14 (2.0%)
- 1e Monte Carlo error, system R(2,920 h) 95% lower bound, most reliable system: mean 0.9999, SE per run 2.9e-06 (0.0%)
- 1e Monte Carlo error, failures per 1,000 vehicles (median), most reliable system: mean 0.02092, SE per run 0.00041 (2.0%)
- 1e Monte Carlo error, FIT (median), TI C2000: mean 4.539, SE per run 0.095 (2.1%)

## Part 2: what the simulator concludes on our data
- 2a All 10 parts demonstrate the target at 55 C (largest p = 1.2e-09); 95% max FIT from 0.379 to 50 vs the target 343 FIT
- 2a Maximum demonstrated temperature: R7F7016903AFP-C 83 C; F280049CPZQR 97 C; TMCS1101A4UQDRQ1 121 C; ADuM4135 152 C; ADuM141E 155 C; LTC6811-1 155 C; UCC21750QDWRQ1 176 C; ISO7741QDWRQ1 176 C; TMP4719QDGSRQ1 179 C; BQ79656PAPRQ1 179 C
- 2b System, most reliable (F280049CPZQR + BQ79656PAPRQ1 + ISO7741QDWRQ1 + TMP4719QDGSRQ1 + UCC21750QDWRQ1 + TMCS1101A4UQDRQ1): 95% lower bound R = 0.999913, p < 0.0002 (share of 5,000 draws with R < target), demonstrated up to 95 C
- 2b System, least reliable (R7F7016903AFP-C + LTC6811-1 + ADuM141E + TMP4719QDGSRQ1 + ADuM4135 + TMCS1101A4UQDRQ1): 95% lower bound R = 0.999766, p < 0.0002 (share of 5,000 draws with R < target), demonstrated up to 78 C
- 2c ECU MCU: F280049CPZQR (0 failures) vs R7F7016903AFP-C (0 failures): exact test p = 1.00, simulation p = 0.30; significant at 0.05: no
- 2c BMS AFE: BQ79656PAPRQ1 (0 failures) vs LTC6811-1 (0 failures): exact test p = 1.00, simulation p = 0.26; significant at 0.05: no
- 2c Digital isolator: ISO7741QDWRQ1 (0 failures) vs ADuM141E (1 failures): exact test p = 0.40, simulation p = 0.15; significant at 0.05: no
- 2c Gate driver: UCC21750QDWRQ1 (0 failures) vs ADuM4135 (0 failures): exact test p = 1.00, simulation p = 0.27; significant at 0.05: no
- 2d system failure rate, 40/70/105 C profile / its 62 C mean: 3.77x (95% CI 2.33-6.46); P(ratio <= 1) = 0.000
